story_type: pararescuemen parachute from an HC-130J to an injured crewman on a vessel 700 nautical miles out
hook: Seven hundred nautical miles out, they went out the back door.
narration: Seven hundred nautical miles out at sea, they jumped.
A crewman on this vessel was severely injured.
Mexico called for help, and California's 129th Rescue Wing took the call.
Within a day, their HC-130J was over the ship.
Pararescuemen are paramedics who parachute in.
They hit the water beside the vessel and climbed aboard.
outcome: They kept him stable on remote Socorro Island and got him to care in Mazatlan, the wing's eleven hundred and ninetieth save.
title: They jumped into the sea to reach him
description:
Pararescuemen from the California Air National Guard's 129th Rescue Wing jumped from an HC-130J into the Pacific on July 7, 2026, to reach a seriously injured crewman 700 nautical miles out at sea. It was the wing's 1,190th save.

Footage: U.S. Air National Guard video by Technical Sgt. Duane Ramos, 129th Rescue Wing, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1015059/1190th-life-saved-129th-rescue-wing
